title: From Arraignment to Resolution: Transformer Models of Court Cases
abstract: arXiv:2611.23518v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The criminal legal system is composed of many complex decision points, such as which charges are pursued, how bond is determined, plea deal negotiations, and sentencing. Given the profound impact of such decisions, there is a growing need to increase the transparency within this system. While prior machine learning approaches have focused on modeling single decisions (e.g., recidivism), this paper proposes a transformer-based time series model to forecast the outcome of the next proceeding in a case (e.g., charges accepted, bond set, plea deal made, etc.). By modeling a case as an event sequence, we enable a more nuanced analysis to support better oversight and understanding of decision making. We conduct an empirical analysis of thousands of cases using a newly constructed dataset derived from publicly available court records of a mid-sized U.S. city. translated_title: 从提审到结案：法院案件的Transformer模型
translated_abstract: 刑事法律系统由许多复杂的决策点组成，例如追诉哪些罪名、如何确定保释金、认罪协议谈判以及量刑判决。鉴于此类决策的深远影响，提高该系统内部透明度的需求日益增长。虽然先前的机器学习方法主要聚焦于对单一决策（如累犯）进行建模，本文提出了一种基于Transformer的时间序列模型，用于预测案件中下一个诉讼程序的结果（例如接受指控、设定保释金、达成认罪协议等）。通过将案件建模为事件序列，我们能够进行更细致的分析，以支持对决策过程更好的监督和理解。我们使用基于美国某中等城市公开法庭记录构建的新数据集，对数千个案例进行了实证分析。我们拟合了将书记员笔记中的文本数据与结构化信息相结合的模型……
tldr: 本文提出基于Transformer的时间序列模型，将法院案件建模为事件序列以预测刑事案件中下一诉讼程序的结果，从而提升司法决策的透明度与可监督性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a transformer-based time series model that frames court cases as event sequences to forecast the outcomes of subsequent legal proceedings, enhancing transparency and oversight of decision-making in the criminal legal system.
